date_convention: Calendar months in UTC; period start inclusive and period end exclusive. Rates are fractions, not percentages.

metrics.name: revenue
metrics.description: Gross cash collected from completed order and subscription payments; refunds reported separately. Not accounting revenue recognition.
metrics.notes: Use orders.region_id for order payments and customers.region_id for subscriptions. Product revenue needs explicit line allocation; never sum whole payments after joining order_items.

metrics.name: monthly_recurring_revenue
metrics.description: Contracted monthly subscription value active on the last calendar day of the month; independent of payment success.
metrics.formula: SUM(monthly_value) WHERE start_date < next_month AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= next_month)
metrics.time_basis: Month-end snapshot; subscription end_date is first inactive day

metrics.name: average_order_value
metrics.description: Mean completed one-off order value, before refunds. Subscription payments excluded.
metrics.empty_period: null when completed order count is zero

metrics.name: refund_rate
metrics.description: Refund amount issued in the month divided by gross completed payments collected in the same month, including subscription payments.
metrics.formula: SUM(refunds.amount by refund_date) / SUM(completed payments.amount by payment_date)
metrics.time_basis: Independent cash-flow dates for numerator and denominator
metrics.empty_period: null when completed payment value is zero
metrics.notes: Not a purchase-cohort refund rate. Refunds may relate to earlier months; rate can exceed 1. Aggregate numerator and denominator separately with identical dimension filters.

metrics.name: customer_churn
metrics.description: Share of the opening subscriber cohort whose subscription ends during the month.
metrics.formula: COUNT(opening cohort with month_start <= end_date < next_month) / COUNT(start_date < month_start AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= month_start))
metrics.time_basis: Active immediately before month start; first-day cancellations count. Same-month entrants excluded.
metrics.empty_period: null when opening cohort is empty
metrics.notes: One subscription lifecycle per customer makes subscriber and customer counts equivalent. This is subscription churn; churned customers may still place one-off orders. Do not use customers.status for historical cohorts.
